description: Search the AstroWay guides: authentication, credits, error codes, field formats, agent setup and every product page. Returns title, URL, section list and the argument to pass to read_doc. No API key needed. For "which endpoint do I call" use find_endpoint instead, which also gives the price.

lang.description: Page language. Default "any"; the guides are written in Ukrainian and mirrored in English.

limit.description: How many pages to return, 1 to 25. Default 5.

query.description: What you want to know, e.g. "rate limits", "timezone format", "webhook signature".

name: search_docs
title: Search Documentation
